providers.label: Providers & models
providers.lede: Aldwin needs an AI model to think and write. A provider is the company or program that runs that model, such as OpenAI, Anthropic, or Ollama on your own computer.

search.label: Search
search.lede: Aldwin uses a search engine to look things up on the web for you. Connect one and choose which it uses.

skills.label: Skills
skills.lede: Skills are saved instructions for a kind of task, like writing release notes in your style. Type @ in a message to use one.

tools.label: Tools
tools.lede: Connect apps like GitHub or Notion so Aldwin can read and work in them for you. Steps that change something in an app need your OK, which for now only the terminal app can give.

advanced.label: Advanced
advanced.lede: How much Aldwin reads and does each time you send a message. The defaults suit most people, and the terminal app uses the same settings.

appearance.label: Appearance
appearance.lede: How Aldwin looks in this browser. These choices stay on this device.
